thread:
Priya K (CS): kickoff for Citrine private/VPC onboarding. TL;DR: app subnets can't reach our collectors, KMS key policy doesn't include Redwood role, and their SIEM shows no audit events. Compliance review next Thurs. owners + ETAs? :calendar:
Leo M (Network): taking egress. their route table for app-10.50.0.0/16 points to TGW but no NAT gateway in 3 AZs. need NAT or an egress appliance. Citrine PM, can you confirm if you want NAT per-AZ or a shared appliance?
citrine-pm: prefer per-AZ NAT for HA. we'll provision nat-05 and share route name.
Leo M (Network): perfect. once route exists i'll add 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-05 to app RTs and open outbound 443 to our collector CIDRs. ETA ~35m.
Ana S (Security): KMS: their key policy is admin-only. they must add either our cross-account role or grant via IAM role with a KMS grant. quick policy snippet we sent: `{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`. ask them to enable the grantTokens flag if using STS chaining.
Marco (Ops): i'll hold on forwarder reload until egress change. if logs missing after NAT, i'll tail and capture errors and coordinate token rotation with Citrine SRE.
deploy-bot: change scheduled 7360001300: apply-nat-route-citrine-app (requires approval).
Leo M (Network): route applied at 7360001325. verified egress path to collector endpoint from app instance (curl https://collector.redwood.ai/health -> 200).
citrine-sre: we updated KMS policy at 7360001350 to add your role and rotated Splunk HEC token earlier; sending token to your vault now.
Marco (Ops): forwarder showed `403 HEC token invalid` between 7360001338-7360001348. reloaded with new token at 7360001356, events resumed at 7360001358. ingestion gap ~10m.
Ana S (Security): ran KMS decrypt test at 7360001365 - success. KMS signoff complete.
Priya K (CS): thanks. action items: Ops to record 10m ingestion gap for compliance and offer a replay, Net to add NAT-per-AZ checklist to onboarding docs, Sec to add KMS policy snippet + note about grantTokens, CS to update renewal risk for Citrine to "monitor-high" until audit clears. schedule 30m retro tomorrow to capture improvements.
Leo M (Network): runbook note: require CIDR + AZ mapping and preferred egress pattern at kickoff. i'll PR that change.
Marco (Ops): offering to run a targeted replay for their audit window if they want. Citrine PM?
citrine-pm: yes please, we'd like the replay and a short evidence pack for auditors. we'll also note token rotation in our change log.
Priya K (CS): will send remediation summary + offer for replay. marking account renewal watch: medium-high. closing thread unless there's more. :white_check_mark:
